title: Final Quote — status filter (show/hide declined etc.)

Today declined lines still LIST on the Final Quote (red pill) but are excluded from the cost cascade + category totals (pV2-INBOX-05); the Project Quote rail already hides them entirely. Filter would let the user collapse the Final Quote to just live lines. Likely a status multi-select above the category cards driving project-estimate.component visibleRows().

title: Supplier store category rail — scope to owner's items incl. drafts
description: Pinned supplier store (/suppliers/:id Store tab) rail calls GET /api/marketplace/categories, which counts GLOBAL is_active items only (SELECT_CATEGORIES in server/src/routes/marketplace.js, no supplier scope, drafts excluded). Result: rail shows global browse counts, not the supplier's own categories — empty ("All Categories 0") for a draft-only store and on sparse catalogues (surfaced on preview). Fix: add supplier (+ owner/admin-gated status) scope to the categories endpoint; marketplace-store.ts categoriesRes passes pinnedSupplierId + statusFilter when pinned, matching the grid's item scope. Auth wrinkle: only owner/admin should see draft counts.
